“Yes,” concurred the Jefe with a grateful bow. “About next Christmas come around and see us, and, if the pressure of our affairs has somewhat eased, then, maybe possibly, we shall find it convenient to go about beginning to attempt to raise the expedition you have requested. In the meantime, good day to you, Senor Morgan.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“You mean that?” Henry demanded with wrathful face.", "sha256": "188cb44c10108ba1badbc8438ced246c2d80267cf52ada6d882f9a8a5946f0e1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1473]", "source_html": "

“You mean that?” Henry demanded with wrathful face.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“The very face he must have worn when he slew Senor Alfaro Solano treacherously from the back,” the Jefe soliloquized ominously.", "sha256": "15b97c1547d6f64b257bc26234ff93a50f0abbe79a16f3914dd3e8341969877e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1474]", "source_html": "

“The very face he must have worn when he slew Senor Alfaro Solano treacherously from the back,” the Jefe soliloquized ominously.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "But Henry ignored the later insult.", "sha256": "1bc758ff3a5c6d65e6030cec4436f7dd74fbc3f1e8eb1980fc1688a5c9733b75", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1475]", "source_html": "

But Henry ignored the later insult.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“I’ll tell you what you are,” he flamed in righteous wrath.", "sha256": "c18f2b3557792aa5de5f9b11eba34b55ed4459ca0669901fb805e8713160ca08", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1476]", "source_html": "

“I’ll tell you what you are,” he flamed in righteous wrath.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“Beware!” the judge cautioned him.", "sha256": "7fcd744399b6c27ca61b6f5a3d51c90b0a35a8bf88d371d04649e6ff8577cc62", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1477]", "source_html": "

“Beware!” the judge cautioned him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“I snap my fingers at you,” Henry retorted. “You have no power over me. I am a full-pardoned man by the President of Panama himself. And this is what you are. You are half-breeds. You are mongrel pigs.”", "sha256": "9052b1f0008cc3decfde7112cab5d8dcc9612b3c7d709ed7a387a3101a354c6c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1478]", "source_html": "

“I snap my fingers at you,” Henry retorted. “You have no power over me. I am a full-pardoned man by the President of Panama himself. And this is what you are. You are half-breeds. You are mongrel pigs.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“Pray proceed, Senor,” said the Jefe, with the suave politeness of deathly rage.", "sha256": "3929ff8990491b3e933594042387ac81becfe2afd3f1d327934d4cf4eb3c9aee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1479]", "source_html": "

“Pray proceed, Senor,” said the Jefe, with the suave politeness of deathly rage.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u018-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“You’ve neither the virtues of the Spaniard nor of the Carib, but the vices of both thrice compounded. “Are you through Senor?—quite through?” the Jefe queried softly.
